note: Reduced model: classical shot geometry only. The orientation features that are xGHub's contribution are not available from this pipeline.
domain: Fitted on open play, free kicks and corners. xGHub contains NO PENALTIES, so the fitted part has never seen one and puts a central shot from the penalty spot at about 0.20 -- right for open play from there, where the dataset's own shots convert at 0.17, and wrong for a penalty. Penalties are therefore not scored by the fit at all: pass is_penalty to predict() and they take the fixed penalty_xg, which is assumed from football's conversion rate rather than fitted here.
